title: CI/CD pipeline
goal: Show a production deployment pipeline with quality gates, approval, and rollback.

rubric.must: Build, test, and security decisions visibly gate the path before staging deployment.
A failed production health-check branch visibly reaches Rollback production and then Incident opened.
Failed build, test, or security outcomes visibly feed a developer notification loop back toward the commit.
Staging integration tests visibly lead to a release-approval decision before production deployment.
Passing production health checks visibly reach the Release complete terminator.
The early commit-to-build path is visually emphasised relative to ordinary connectors.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the flowchart exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: The target visibly communicates the requested deployment pipeline. Its branches and feedback loops are traceable, labels are readable, and there are no material overlaps or cropping.

items.evidence: Build succeeds?, Tests pass?, and Findings acceptable? each gate the path before Deploy to staging; failed outcomes route to Notify developer.
The No branch from Health checks pass? leads to Rollback production, then Incident opened.
No branches from the build, tests, and security decisions reach Notify developer; a dashed loop returns toward Commit merged.
Run integration tests leads to Release approved?; its Yes branch leads to Deploy production, while No leads to Hold release.
The Yes branch from Health checks pass? reaches the Release complete terminator.
The Commit merged-to-Build artifact connector is visibly thicker than ordinary connectors.
